【Abstract · abstract-1-1】The use of magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) in radiotherapy (RT) planning is rapidly expanding.

【Abstract · abstract-1-3】However a number of challenges are also considered: the requirements that MR images are acquired in the RT treatment position, that they are geometrically accurate, that effects of patient motion during the scan are minimized, that tissue markers are clearly demonstrated, that an estimate of electron density can be obtained.
